summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue datepicker component but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily-obfuscated blob (string-array rotation via `WV8StW`, large numeric literal arrays, hex-mangled identifiers such as `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `JqTtnbZ`) marked with the `// @bun @bun-cjs` header so it can only be executed by the fetched Bun binary — never by Node. This runs automatically during `npm install`, executing opaque author-controlled code on the installer's machine that is unrelated to any datepicker functionality. The alternate-runtime choice specifically evades Node-based inspection tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
